article:
The fxsvgConverter.jar Jar file contains the library which allows to convert a JavaFX tree to a SVG file.
If also allows to convert a JavaFX tree to a Graphics2D, see for more information.
To convert a JavaFX tree to a SVG file, you can use one of the convert methods of the class.
You can reuse the same SVGConverter for more than one JavaFX Node conversion.
SVGConverter converter = new SVGConverter(); converter.convert(<my JavaFX root>, <my SVG file>);
